question: Nikhil Kumar  get all details emp id claim id list claims he appiled for
sql: SELECT T1.employee_id, T2.claim_id, T2.claim_date, T2.trip_purpose, T2.trip_city, T2.trip_start, T2.trip_end, T2.total_amount, T2.approved_amount, T2.status, T2.approval_level, T2.approver_id, T2.payment_date, T2.approval_date, T2.exception_code, T2.reason FROM employees AS T1 JOIN expense_claims AS T2 ON T1.employee_id = T2.employee_id WHERE T1.name = 'Nikhil Kumar' LIMIT 500
